title: Release 0.14.0 (quest half of the lore+quest pair; LCLI-705)
description: Quest half of the paired lore+quest v0.14.0 release (constitution Article 3). lore-cli ships LCLI-705 (Lore pane opening in teammate sessions); every release is a pair at one version, so quest ships 0.14.0 with the 55 commits on dev since 0.13.0. Follows docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md. Prep only until team-lead says otherwise: version bump PR to dev; merge, promotion, tag, staging, qualification and promotion to latest each come on the leader word, and npm publish and tag push are operator dialogs.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Version strings read 0.14.0 at every site the runbook lists, and check:packages, check:lockfile and the breaking-bump pair check pass on the bump PR head

The CHANGELOG carries a dated ## 0.14.0 section and a fresh empty ## Unreleased above it at the tag

Known record defect, fixed forward, 2026-10-20 (opum-doc relay 893). The v0.14.1 tag (object ad34fcd6, peels to 053d8595) carries a CHANGELOG.md whose headings are Unreleased then 0.14.0, with NO 0.14.1 heading; runbook step 5 (finalize the changelog before tagging) was skipped for 0.14.1. The tag is NOT moved: the staged 0.14.1-rc.1 bytes are receipt-bound and moving a tag is a tier-3 rewrite. Fix forward by a CHANGELOG-only PR into dev (opum-ai/quest-cli#632, 6c4a20f) adding the 0.14.1 heading dated 2026-10-20 above the republish note with an empty Unreleased above it. Consumers cite the CHANGELOG at quest-cli main after promotion, not at the tag. promote-release.mjs reads release notes at the tagged commit, so its release-cut step is expected to refuse for 0.14.1; that is for the leader to rule on before the promote step. The refusal-earlier fix is filed as QCLI-514.

Promote-refusal finding with citations, 2026-10-20 (relays 893/894; DEC-204 (3), ruled A). docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md step 5 (finalize the changelog, then tag; "the tag has to carry this edit") and the GitHub Release paragraph (notes read at the commit the tag peels to, QCLI-398/QCLI-407; refuses before any tag moves, dry run included, when the section is missing). scripts/promote-release.mjs: resolveTagCommit(version) at ~L764, then releaseNotesFor(version, { commit: peeled.commit }) at ~L889 and refusal "Refusing to promote <version>: <detail>" when notes.ok is false. The tagged commit 053d8595 has no 0.14.1 heading, so the dry run is expected to refuse. Fix-forward: PR #632 (CHANGELOG-only) then promote-release.mjs --notes-from <sha> (accepted only for a descendant of the tag commit that touches CHANGELOG.md alone), used once for 0.14.1. Where promote runs from: promote-release.mjs takes its version from package.json in the checkout root (~L735) and binds the bundle to the tag peel, not to HEAD, so it can run from a dev checkout whose package.json reads 0.14.1; publish-release.mjs differs and refuses unless HEAD is the receipt commit (observed 2026-10-20). Refusal-earlier follow-up for the next pair: QCLI-514.

The notes parser (scripts/github-release.mjs L104) tolerates the date suffix. Verdict verbatim:

VERDICT: APPROVE (opum-ai/quest-cli#632, head 6c4a20fb1e0eff4c12a14623d640b739af1cd079)

1. CONFIRMED. The diff has one file, CHANGELOG.md, with +2 lines: `## 0.14.1 - 2026-10-20` and a blank line (hunk @@ -10,6 +10,8 @@). Nothing is removed or reworded. I read only the diff file, so "only one file" rests on the compare-API output.

2. CONFIRMED. CHANGELOG.md:11 is `## Unreleased`, :12 is blank, :13 is `## 0.14.1 - 2026-10-20`. Nothing sits between them.

3. CONFIRMED. Lines 17-21 read: "**0.14.1 republishes 0.14.0's content, because 0.14.0 was tagged and never published** (DEC-204 (2); QCLI-499). Both sides' `v0.14.0` tags exist and stay immutable, but lore's release gate caught a defect before either side published, so the pair moved to 0.14.1 under Constitution Article 3. Only the version strings move here; the code is 0.14.0's."

4. CONFIRMED on form, with two points that need your judgement.
 - Form: dated headings in the file use `## X.Y.Z - YYYY-MM-DD`. That covers 0.11.0 (:706), 0.10.0, 0.9.0, 0.8.0, 0.7.1, 0.7.0, 0.6.2, 0.6.1, 0.6.0 and 0.5.0. Never-published tags carry a suffix: 0.8.0 (:937) and 0.6.1 (:1575) read `- <date> (tagged, never published)`.
 - Mix: a mix of dated and undated headings is already the file's norm. 0.14.0 (:23), 0.13.0 (:131) and 0.12.0 (:253) are undated.
 - Header rule (:7-9): "dated with the UTC day `@opum-ai/quest` reached npm, read from the registry's `time` field. 0.6.1, 0.8.0 and 0.14.0 never reached npm, so each is dated by its own tag. No date here is inferred (QCLI-398)."
 - UNVERIFIED: whether 2026-10-20 is consistent with that rule. A tag date is permitted only for the versions the header lists as never published, and 0.14.1 is not one of them. Under the rule it takes the npm `time` day. If 0.14.1 is tagged but not yet on npm, it has no npm date. Then 2026-10-20 must be the v0.14.1 tag's own date, which I cannot read without a shell.
 - To verify: `git for-each-ref refs/tags/v0.14.1 --format='%(taggerdate:iso-strict)'`, and `npm view @opum-ai/quest time` for 0.14.1. The tag object is more likely to match than the npm date, because staging is still pending per the renewal handoff, #631.
 - Judgement for you: if the date comes from the tag, the header sentence is silently stale, because it says only 0.14.0 and the others are tag-dated. This PR does not touch the header and I would not block on that, but a header edit or a follow-up note would keep "no date is inferred" literally true.

5. CONFIRMED. Both `## 0.14.1` and `## 0.14.1 - 2026-10-20` match a `## <version>` prefix reader. The section runs from :13 to just before `## 0.14.0` at :23, and holds the blank line, `### Changed`, and the single bullet at :17-21 plus its trailing blank. Nothing from `## Unreleased` or `## 0.14.0` is included.
 - Caveat: a reader that matches the heading by exact equality (`## 0.14.1`) would miss the ` - 2026-10-20` suffix. Every dated heading in the file already has the suffix, so any existing reader must tolerate it.
